item.title: Street Fighter 6 sales top six million
item.description: Total sales for Street Fighter 6 have surpassed six million units worldwide, Capcom announced.

item.description: miHoYo has announced Varsapura, its next major open-world game currently in development on Unreal Engine 5. Platforms and a release date were not announced, but the company is recruiting for severaâ¦

item.title: Winning Post 10 2026 announced for PS5, Switch 2, PS4, Switch, and PC
item.description: Koei Tecmo has announced horse racing simulation game Winning Post 10 2026 for PlayStation 5, Switch 2, PlayStation 4, Switch, and PC (Steam). It will launch on March 26, 2026 in Japan.

item.title: Code Vein II character trailer – Josee Anjou
item.description: Bandai Namco has released a new trailer for Code Vein II introducing character Josee Anjou.

item.title: Genshin Impact Version Luna III update ‘Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude – A Nocturne of the Far North’ launches December 3
item.description: The Version Luna III update for Genshin Impact, dubbed “Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude – A Nocturne of the Far North,” will launch on December 3, developer miHoYo announced.

item.title: Nioh 3 reveals Bakumatsu period
item.description: The Bakumatsu period will join the Edo, Sengoku, and Heian periods in dark samurai action RPG sequel Nioh 3, publisher Koei Tecmo and developer Team NINJA announced.
